name: owl-mcp

tools.name: add_annotation_assertion
tools.description: Add an annotation assertion (AnnotationAssertion) where the literal VALUE is supplied as a separate field. Use this instead of add_axiom for long or special-character values.

datatype.description: Optional datatype IRI or CURIE (e.g. 'xsd:string'). Ignored if `lang` is set.

lang.description: Optional language tag (e.g. 'en'); produces a language-tagged literal.

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

property.description: Annotation property IRI or CURIE, e.g. 'rdfs:label'

subject.description: Subject IRI or CURIE the annotation applies to

value.description: The literal value, stored verbatim (no escaping required)

tools.name: add_axiom
tools.description: Add a single OWL axiom in functional syntax to the ontology file. E.g. SubClassOf(:Dog :Animal)

axiom_str.description: Axiom in OWL functional syntax, e.g. SubClassOf(:Dog :Animal)

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

tools.name: add_axioms
tools.description: Add multiple OWL axioms in functional syntax to the ontology file. Stops on the first failure.

axiom_strs.description: List of axioms in OWL functional syntax

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

tools.name: add_class_assertion
tools.description: Add a class assertion (ClassAssertion) stating that an individual is an instance of a class.

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

tools.name: add_data_property_assertion
tools.description: Add a data property assertion (DataPropertyAssertion) where the literal VALUE is supplied as a separate field. Use this instead of add_axiom for long or special-character values.

datatype.description: Optional datatype IRI or CURIE (e.g. 'xsd:string'). Ignored if `lang` is set.

lang.description: Optional language tag (e.g. 'en'); produces a language-tagged literal.

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

property.description: Data property IRI or CURIE, e.g. 'pf:metaprops' or '<http://example.org/metaprops>'

value.description: The literal value, stored verbatim (no escaping required)

tools.name: add_object_property_assertion
tools.description: Add an object property assertion (ObjectPropertyAssertion) linking a subject individual to a target individual via an object property.

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

subject.description: Subject individual IRI or CURIE (the `from` individual)

target.description: Target individual IRI or CURIE (the `to` individual)

tools.name: add_prefix
tools.description: Add a prefix mapping (e.g. prefix='ex:' uri='http://example.org/') to the ontology file.

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

uri.description: The full IRI the prefix expands to, e.g. 'http://example.org/'

tools.name: check_consistency
tools.description: Run an OWL 2 EL reasoner (whelk; alias elk) over one or more OWL files and report logical consistency. Reasoning is limited to the OWL 2 EL profile.

output_path.description: If set, write the reasoned ontology (asserted + inferred SubClassOf) to this path

owl_file_paths.description: Absolute paths to the OWL files to load and merge before reasoning

reasoner.description: Reasoner id: "whelk" (default) or "elk" (synonym). Only OWL 2 EL is supported.

tools.name: find_axioms
tools.description: Search axioms in an OWL file using a regex pattern. Returns matching axioms (up to limit).

annotation_property.description: IRI or CURIE of the annotation property to use for labels (default: rdfs:label)

include_labels.description: If true, append human-readable labels after ## comments

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100)

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against functional-syntax axiom strings

tools.name: get_all_axioms
tools.description: Return all axioms in the OWL file (up to limit).

annotation_property.description: IRI or CURIE of the annotation property to use for labels (default: rdfs:label)

include_labels.description: If true, append human-readable labels after ## comments

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100)

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

tools.name: get_labels_for_iri
tools.description: Return all label values for a given IRI or CURIE in the ontology file. Defaults to rdfs:label.

annotation_property.description: IRI or CURIE of the annotation property (default: rdfs:label)

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

tools.name: ontology_metadata
tools.description: Return the ontology-level annotation axioms (metadata header) for the given OWL file.

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

tools.name: remove_axiom
tools.description: Remove a single OWL axiom (given in functional syntax) from the ontology file.

axiom_str.description: Axiom in OWL functional syntax to remove

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

tools.name: set_ontology_iri
tools.description: Set or update the ontology IRI (and optional version IRI) for an OWL file. Pass iri=null to clear the ontology IRI.

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

tools.name: sparql_query
tools.description: Run a SPARQL query over one or more OWL files. Returns SPARQL 1.1 JSON results for SELECT/ASK, and N-Triples for CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE. Set with_reasoning=true to materialize OWL 2 EL entailments before querying.

owl_file_paths.description: Absolute paths to the OWL files to load and merge into one RDF graph before querying

query.description: The SPARQL query string (SELECT, ASK, CONSTRUCT, or DESCRIBE)

with_reasoning.description:
When true, materialize OWL 2 EL inferred SubClassOf axioms (via whelk) before querying.
Default false (asserted triples only).

tools.name: test_pitfalls
tools.description: Scan an OWL ontology for common modeling pitfalls (inspired by OOPS!). Returns a JSON report listing detected issues, their severity, and affected elements.

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

pitfalls.description: Comma-separated list of pitfall IDs to check (e.g. "P04,P08,P11"). If omitted, all checks run.

tools.name: test_quality
tools.description: Evaluate the quality of an OWL ontology using the OQuaRE framework (based on ISO/IEC 25000 SQuaRE). Returns a JSON report with metrics, characteristics, and an overall 1-5 score.

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

tools.name: verbalize
tools.description: Convert OWL axioms into Controlled Natural Language (pseudo-text) and a Turtle fragment. If iri is omitted, verbalizes owl:Class and owl:NamedIndividual entities (up to limit).

iri.description: Optional IRI or CURIE of a single class or individual to verbalize

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to verbalize when `iri` is omitted (default: 100)

owl_file_path.description: Absolute path to the OWL file

instructions: Use the OWL tools to load, query and modify OWL ontology files. Axioms are expressed in OWL Functional Syntax. resource://active lists ontology files currently cached in this process (not durable state).
